binding.gate: report both existing nonsacred pools; no worse than U0 by >2 items/pool; collapse=0; no binding-acquisition claim
binding.params: all 984321 binding/localizer parameters frozen; no T3 binding training

corpus.construction: corrected generator: assignment x query x fact-order x template; name-swap families; fixed candidate order; deterministic IDs; family/name/template-disjoint splits

gates.retention: TRAIN16 not primary T3 corpus; language and binding preservation are mandatory
gates.shortcut: nuisance probes must not explain held-out relational result; failure is T3_SHORTCUT_FAILURE

language.gate: DEV CE <= own U0 + 0.25 nat at required checkpoints; no nonfinite metrics; terminal train-dev gap <=0.5

location.anchor: first defining factual mention of each candidate; mean over every name token in the span, including leading-space subtoken and excluding punctuation; exact token spans saved per row
location.decision: BOS-prefixed index len(prompt_token_ids), final_norm output at final context/query token; predicts first answer token

objective.native: T2 length-normalized hardest-distractor pairwise margin hinge, M=1.0; no prompt/continuation CE, no EOS supervision, no KL, no localization term
objective.new: For each QA row, q=final_norm hidden at final prompt token; k+ and k- are mean final_norm states over the full token span of each candidate first factual mention. L_ptr=-log(exp(cos(q,k+)/tau)/(exp(cos(q,k+)/tau)+exp(cos(q,k-)/tau)))
objective.normalization: L2 cosine; no trainable pointer head; gradients to q and both anchors

parent.lineage: Phase1G U6000 best; no T2 descendant

schedule.cadence: 9 corrected contextual QA updates then 1 Phase1G language rehearsal

scientific_question: Can explicit base-model relational representation supervision produce held-out counterfactual identity selection and improve native output?

seeds.schedule_seed_rule: seed-specific deterministic family permutation; identical corpus and rule

sole_intervention: parameter-free normalized query-to-candidate pointer loss added to the frozen T2 candidate-margin treatment

stopping.early_u100: descriptive only; stop only integrity/nonfinite or catastrophic language/binding failure
stopping.terminal: classify at U500; no post-result rescue, gate movement, or locked-panel access
stopping.test_policy: T3 TEST scored once only after terminal commit and only if DEV representation/native gates pass
